title: The Billings a Late Fee Is Taken On at Each Stage of a Project
content:
# The Billings a Late Fee Is Taken On at Each Stage of a Project

Not every line on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects carries a late fee while the work is still running, and retainage the owner has never been invoiced cannot be overdue at all.

## Rule

Where the project stands substantially complete and retainage stands withheld on it, the amount the fee is taken on is everything billed by way of deposit, mobilisation, progress and change order billings, less the retainage withheld from those billings and less every payment received, because retainage the owner has never been invoiced cannot be overdue.

Where the project has not reached substantial completion and has not closed, the amount the fee is taken on is the progress billings alone less every payment received, the deposit and the mobilisation fee not carrying a late fee while the work is still running.

In every other case the amount the fee is taken on is everything billed by way of deposit, mobilisation, progress and change order billings, less every payment received.

## Which case a project falls in

| Status of the project | Retainage withheld standing on it | The amount the fee is taken on |
|---|---|---|
| substantially complete | yes | the four kinds of billing, less the retainage withheld and less payments received |
| substantially complete | none | the four kinds of billing, less payments received |
| estimated, awarded, scheduled or in progress | with or without | the progress billings alone, less payments received |
| closed | with or without | the four kinds of billing, less payments received |

Where payments received come to more than the billings counted, the amount the fee is taken on is nothing and no fee arises from it.

## Worked amounts (hypothetical)

A project in progress with a deposit of USD 40000, a mobilisation fee of USD 3500, progress billings of USD 90000 and payments of USD 43500: the fee is taken on USD 46500, the progress billings alone less the payments. The same project once substantially complete, with USD 9000 of retainage withheld: the fee is taken on 133500 less 9000 less 43500, that is USD 81000.
